description: Enable or disable the delete protection of a DNS zone. Enabling is immediate; DISABLING removes the last safeguard against delete_zone and therefore needs a confirm_token, exactly like a deletion.

confirm_token.description: Confirmation token from the previous call of this same tool with identical arguments. Omit on the first call — the server then returns a token that is valid for a few minutes.

delete.description: true to protect the zone from deletion, false to unprotect

zone.description: ID or name of the zone, e.g. "example.com"

name: change_zone_protection
title: Change zone protection
